about_the_game: Cut through the haunted forest and rescue some kid from a creepy witch and her gang of suicide ghosts. Collect cards with powerful abilities as you try to fight the darkness, Detective Lady stars in this 2.5HD card based rogue-like deck builder. Can you survive the woods?

content_descriptors.notes: Violence and horror themes, no gore, the game is set in the suicide forest.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5‑6600K / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB) / AMD RX 560 (4 GB) or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5‑9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 or AMD RX 5700 (6 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: A horror-themed, cartoon, 2.5HD Rogue-like Deck Builder. Hit comic Detective Lady investigates a haunted woodland where evidence talks back. Build a deck, confront lingering truths, and choose your path through a living maze.
